name: hackmate
description: Hackmate - College-Exclusive Hackathon Teammate Matchmaker & Chat

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,emerald.bold" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.setup: npm run install-all && npm run seed
scripts.install-all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
